source: Figma 'Thread - Design Assets' (Filigran marketing, exported Oct 2026): the official lockup (white, and the same paths in dark ink for light slides), the mosaic 't' emblem, the 't' glyph, the gradient app icon and two mosaic artworks (re-encoded as WebP for size, pixels unchanged). The Filigran figures, product logos and logo libraries are included from their packs, never copied.

assets.description: Official THREAD lockup, white: the thread- wordmark with its 'powered by Filigran' baseline - drawn by the deck chrome on every dark slide.
Official THREAD lockup in dark ink (#0a0a0a): the same thread- wordmark and 'powered by Filigran' baseline for a light page - drawn by the deck chrome on every light slide.
THREAD emblem: the 't' glyph filled with the grained pixel mosaic in the THREAD colours, on transparent - drawn by the chrome in the top-right corner of the content and section slides.
The THREAD 't' glyph alone, near-white on transparent - a sign-off mark next to a call to action, never a replacement for the lockup.
THREAD app icon: the white 't' on a rounded square in the THREAD gradient (blue to cyan to lime) - for a small badge next to a QR code or an app mention.

THREAD mosaic cluster, transparent background: grained tiles of mixed sizes in the THREAD colours (lilac, coral, lime, cyan, pink, blue, orange) - a design element for a statement or quote slide, in an image block beside the text.
THREAD mosaic, scattered: a loose spread of grained tiles in the THREAD colours, transparent background - a wide design element under or beside a headline.
Filigran wordmark (cyan mark + white wordmark), light-on-dark - for an 'About Filigran' or 'powered by Filigran' slide of a THREAD deck.
Filigran symbol alone, near-white - next to a Filigran product or a company fact on a THREAD slide.
